person: Tobias Brenner, a freelance sound engineer in Denver whose checked bag on a flight to Reykjavik arrived three days late. He kept the receipts in an envelope and answers precisely.

stated_up_front.text: The bag finally reached my hotel on 6 October, around 7 in the evening.

sheet.truth: Ask me first: show me the list of expenses before you put it in the complaint.
Go ahead with the bag fee refund, no need to ask me. It was $40.

sheet.about: when the delayed bag was delivered
sheet.truth: The bag was delivered to my hotel on 6 October 2026 at about 7 pm.

sheet.about: whether his card's baggage delay benefit already paid for anything
sheet.truth: Yes, my card's delay benefit already paid $85 for a rain jacket.

sheet.about: whether anyone else's purchases are among the receipts
sheet.truth: I traveled alone; every receipt is mine.
